reason: My clients would not want a bot sitting in their group chats, and the one thing I sell is that they deal with me, not a machine. I might forward a few receipts myself to try the free 30, but my clients together send far more than 100 documents a month, and $35 a month comes out of my own pocket on fixed fees I can't raise.
objection: Putting a bot into my clients' chats looks unprofessional and makes them nervous about who sees their invoices and bank transfers. If one client complains, I lose a fee that's worth more than the tool.
would_change_my_mind: If I could use it privately on my side, one sheet per client and no bot in their chats, at a price I could pass on to clients or under $10 a month.
